26. Begane to inuocate. I Seth was a moſt holie man, and ſo broughtvp his
children, that they were called the ſonnes of God. Gen. 6. Adam alſo and Eue
were penitent, and became great confeffors, and are now Sainctes. And ſo it
can not be doubted but amongſt o thet ſpiritual exerciſes they prayed and in-
uocated God: And therfore that which is here ſaid : He ( towit Enos ) begane or
as the Hebrew hath) then was begune, to inuocate the name of our Lord, can not
be vnderſtood of priuate, but of ſome publique prayer of many meeting toge-
ather, & obſeruing ſome rites & ſet forme in peculiar place dedicated to diuine
Seruice , the Church being now growne to a competent multitude. And that
beſides Sacrifice, whichwas alfo before, as appeareth both by Cain & Abel.
